# Skills index (generated by tools/skill_index.py; do not edit)

## ads
- ads-layer-generic - Provider-agnostic ads: adapter, policy and static facade layers, fake Editor provider, consent state, placement enum. Use when adding or porting ads to any game.
- ads-popup-flow - Implement an ad/monetization sheet (interstitial/rewarded popups, boosters, show-conditions, placements) on top of the project ads SDK wrapper. Use when given an ad placement sheet or asked for inter/reward popups or boosters.

## agent
- agent-team-protocol - Coordinator rules for running many subagents on one Unity project: model tiering, brief template, FIFO Editor lock with heartbeat, keep-compiling, denial handling, report format. Use when dispatching or acting as a subagent on a shared Editor.

## ambience
- ambience-layers - Per-zone ambience: crossfaded loops, safe vs danger music, budgeted 3D loops, random one-shots with cooldown, ducking, tier-gated particles, toggle obedience. Use when zones or biomes should feel alive after the audio system exists.

## analytics
- analytics-events-taxonomy - Analytics event taxonomy: naming rules, parameter limits, standard event groups, funnels, per-game docs/analytics-events.md. Use before adding any logged event.

## art
- art-volume-bloom-parity - Diagnose glare on ported models: compare the scene's post Volume with the reference's before touching materials or runtime exposure hacks; find leftover root renderers after a model swap. Use when pets or characters bloom too much.

## asset
- asset-transfer-closure - Copy prefabs/models/VFX/UI/audio between Unity projects with full dependency closure and original GUIDs via a resolver script. Use for any cross-project asset move, or when Missing/pink materials appear after a copy.

## async
- async-cancellation - Own UniTask work with CancelToken so it stops on disable, destroy or restart. Use when writing delays, waits, loops or loads that can outlive their owner.

## auto
- auto-balance-game - Use when a Roblox clone needs all time-sensitive gameplay stats generated from a full-game playtime target, daily session budget, optional milestone timeline, or additional balance constraints.
- auto-balance-loop - Use when a generated balance plan must be simulated, tuned within a bounded iteration cap, materialized into Unity configs and verified against a fresh-save PlayMode target.

## boot
- boot-sequence-setup - Set up or debug game boot order: data preload/warmup, one-time init hooks, settings-to-audio binding, static resets. Use when adding startup code or when a save, factory or manager is not ready at startup.

## bot
- bot-brain-waypoints - Bots that run an obby course: same character with an AI driver, class states, waypoint graph with grid lookup, 3-ray jump avoidance, stuck checks, rubber-band teleport, one-per-frame spawn, and a waypoint graph checker. Use when adding bot racers or chasers.
- bot-path-follow-smoothing - Fix jittery bots on waypoint paths at speed: corner-pass test, speed hint, last-leg easing, turn-rate limit, fresh direction between throttled ticks, jitter harness. Use when bots wobble, orbit waypoints or snap their facing.

## bots
- bots-as-players - Make bots look and behave like other players in a single-player clone: same character prefab, AI driver, random allowed skins and names, nametags, one-per-frame spawn, fake runner skin swaps. Use when a multiplayer game is cloned offline and the world must feel populated.

## camera
- camera-occlusion-fade - Cheap third-person occluder fade: segment-vs-bounds test on a registered target list every 0.05-0.1 s, hysteresis, shared transparent twin material, instant or timed fade. Use when props or models block the player view.

## char
- char-animator-reference-parity - Make a ported character animate exactly like the reference when bone names differ: keep the reference controller, retarget clips, port its parameter driver, verify with a play-mode state probe. Use when animation breaks after a rig swap.

## character
- character-emotes-nametags - Emotes (animator trigger layer, emote wheel) and nametags (single world-space label with a CullingGroup band). Use when the GDD has emotes, player names over heads, or chat-bubble style labels.
- character-perf-budgets - Numeric budgets for player and bot characters on low-end Android: triangles, bones, materials, textures, animators, ragdolls, shadows, nametags, crowd LOD. Use when approving skins, sizing bot counts, or reviewing character performance.
- character-rig-and-animation-contract - Rule: one Character_Rig_Asset per skeleton family, fixed Animator parameter names, rig-owned controller, culling modes, no per-skin materials, slots by id. Use when adding a skin, rig, animation set or animator parameter.
- character-skin-importer - Validate and import a new skin: catalog and prefab checker (skeleton hash, bones, materials, animator, ragdoll, camera/light, budgets) plus an Editor importer template that wires refs and bakes thumbnails. Use when adding any skin or rig, or in local batch runner over the character prefabs.
- character-skin-system - Character skin chain: Character_Skin_Asset, rig asset, Factory_Character, Data_Character, equip/unlock events, shared-mesh swap gated by skeleton hash, unlock types and per-mode type gating. Use when building the skin system or adding skins to a clone.

## checkpoint
- checkpoint-respawn - Checkpoints, fall detection and the revive loop: ICheckpoint, manager and static queries, saved progress, respawn delay, camera reset. Use when adding checkpoints, kill zones, falling death or respawn to an obby or tower.

## clone
- clone-feature-recipes - Use when a clone feature needs a reusable behavior/data/config/UI/wiring contract without hard-coded genre-specific balance values.
- clone-ip-safety - Asset provenance and IP hygiene for clones: track asset origin, flag ripped/trademarked content, store-safe naming. Use when importing from a reference game, naming the game, or before a public build/store listing.
- clone-pipeline - Entry point for cloning a Roblox-style game to Unity mobile: maps phase -> skills -> gates, and holds the per-game docs/clone-plan.md. Use at project start, \"what's next\", or when unsure which skill applies.

## collision
- collision-registry - Route trigger and collision contacts through the framework OptCollisionRegister and OptCollisionSensor instead of per-object OnTrigger with GetComponent. Use when adding any pickup, platform, zone, checkpoint or hazard.

## combat
- combat-health-status - HP, damage, shield, status effects and boss HP phases: IDamageable, DamageInfo, health events, status priority rules, respawn timing. Use when characters, eggs or bosses need health or timed effects.
- combat-hit-detection-rule - Rule for finding hit targets cheaply: no per-frame weapon collider, NonAlloc overlap or static target list, squared range plus cone dot, projectile sensors through the registry. Use whenever code decides who an attack hits.

## config
- config-and-factory-authoring - Author config ScriptableObject entries and register them in a Factory with validated lookups, naming and folders, plus a static registry audit. Use when adding authored data entries (skins, items, minigames, pools) to a project.
- config-driven-feature - Build a feature end to end data-driven: persistent data, config assets, factory/registry, events, runtime consumer, wiring. Use when adding any system with tunable values, saved state or many entries (\"add X system\").

## cosmetic
- cosmetic-slot-providers - Equippable cosmetic slots (aura, trail, wing, pet) with asset SO, data block, equip event and a provider that toggles pre-baked visuals; pet follow tick. Use when adding auras, trails, wings or pets to the character.

## culling
- culling-group-distance - Event-driven distance culling with CullingGroup for sprites, world text and small props, plus camera far-clip zones. Use when many small renderers cost CPU or an enclosed stage should render less.

## currency
- currency-spread-fx - Make rewards (money, gems, speed) fly from source to the HUD currency bar with count-up, using the reference currency-spread kit. Use for any reward grant/claim, IAP pack, ad reward, or "no fly effect".

## data
- data-block-template - Author a new persistent data domain with DataBlock and DataValue (Data_X, ??= back-fill, keyed records). Use when adding saved player state such as currency, unlocks, settings or progress.
- data-persistence-facts - Facts about how DataBlock saves and loads (triggers, path, key, failure behavior, serializer). Use when debugging lost saves, save timing, migrations or a data change that did not persist.

## debug
- debug-cheats-menu - Dev-only cheat/debug menu (set money/zone, spawn, timeScale, reset save) with a ready IMGUI component. Use at project start or whenever testing needs fast state setup or skipping grind.

## device
- device-tier-policy - Tier devices at runtime (Low/Medium/High) and apply render, physics and per-object policies without swapping the URP asset. Use when a low-end Android crashes, runs hot, or when setting up quality tiers.

## done
- done-means-wired - Definition of done for Unity features: wired in scene/prefab, configs created, refs assigned, compiled, exercised in Play Mode. Use before reporting any feature done, or when \"can't click / not showing\" after delivery.

## economy
- economy-loop-archetypes - Economy loop archetypes for Roblox clones: earn-spend-upgrade, collect-sell, hatch-merge, rebirth, with sinks, sources and pacing checks. Use when turning GDD economy into systems.
- economy-progression-design - Use when a clone needs economy or progression behavior but the GDD has missing, partial, or conflicting prices, rewards, drops, timers, or progression values.

## editor
- editor-lane-single-writer - Rule: one Unity Editor is one project and one writer; only one agent mutates scenes, prefabs, assets and settings at a time, others work in file-lane worktrees. Use when dispatching parallel agents or when two agents might touch the same scene or prefab.
- editor-tool-authoring - Write safe, idempotent, chunked Editor tools (bakers, builders, installers) run via MCP, with guards, file results and saved scenes. Use for any script that generates/mutates many objects or assets, or after a hang/duplicate/lost-scene.

## factory
- factory-singleton-template - Create a Factory_X ScriptableObjectSingleton registry/tuning asset and wire it so it exists in builds. Use when adding a feature config registry, shared tuning values or prefab references.

## feedback
- feedback-notes-sync - Keep docs/feedback-notes.md as durable log and task queue of user corrections and queued requests. Use at session start, on every correction/preference, and when a request arrives mid-task.

## framework
- framework-version-map - Identify whether a Unity project uses CodeSketch (v1) or SketchEngine (v2) and map APIs between them. Use before writing any code against the in-house framework, or when porting code between projects.

## freelook
- freelook-third-person-camera - Cinemachine FreeLook player camera with the reference orbit values, zero damping, touch-drag input, speed FOV, far-clip zones, occluder fade, shake and teleport warp. Use when building or tuning the third-person camera of a clone.

## game
- game-audio-system - Mobile audio layer: BGM crossfade, pooled SFX, config assets, factory, event-driven sounds, volume channels, provenance. Use when the game lacks sound, adding BGM/SFX, or audio causes memory/perf issues.
- game-clone-recon - Start-of-clone recon: feature inventory, system breakdown, reference map, fidelity labels, staged build order before any code. Use on \"clone game X\", \"make a game like X\", or shared reference screenshots/videos.
- game-feel-polish - Juice for mobile games: reward fly-to-HUD, floating numbers, count-up, shake, hit-stop, haptics, rarity VFX, UI tweens. Use after the core loop works or when the game feels flat or dead.
- game-orchestrator - Run the GDD-to-Unity-game pipeline end to end: lint the GDD, generate the task graph, dispatch subagents by lane, enforce gates and definition of done, keep resumable state. Use when the user hands over a GDD or says build, continue or resume a game clone.

## gameplay
- gameplay-pause-input-gate - Pause with Time.timeScale 0 while waiting for a player action that a physics step must run: resume on the press, not the result, or the game freezes. Use for tutorial pauses and freeze-until-tap prompts.
- gameplay-polish-recipes - Small reusable recipes: counted input lock, wall-edge decor kit, re-placing ported props, test hygiene traps. Use when locking input during sequences, adding decor to baked maps, or fixing crowded ported layouts.
- gameplay-video-analysis - Turn gameplay videos, play notes and screenshots into a structured flow/UI/economy/FTUE analysis. Use when given a YouTube link, "I played it and noticed...", or timestamps of a reference game.

## gdd
- gdd-intake - Turn a Roblox game's videos, screenshots and play notes into a lint-clean GDD package: scaffold, evidence ingest, draft with unknowns, batched questions, UI layout contracts, reference match, lint loop and sign-off. Use when a human wants a clone and only has footage and notes.
- gdd-schema - The machine-readable GDD package format: folder layout, ids, evidence tokens, fidelity and priority, per-system-type front-matter, UI layout contracts, templates and a worked example. Use when writing, reviewing or consuming a GDD for the clone pipeline.
- gdd-to-game-fast-path - Thin ordered playbook from GDD to playable build with the fewest tokens: first-30-minutes checklist, skills per phase, gates, what to skip, common pitfalls. Use when kicking off a clone or when the next step is unclear.

## genre
- genre-playbooks - Map a Roblox genre (obby, tower climb, simulator, tycoon, pet collector, steal, escape, racing, mining, arena) to the systems and skills a clone needs. Use at planning when the GDD names a genre.

## graphify
- graphify-workflow - Always-on for Unity projects - at session start bootstrap Graphify (install, build graph, start the single watcher) without asking, and prefer graphify query/path/explain over reading code. Also covers scope, auto-update and watcher fixes. Install, scope, auto-update and query a local code-only Graphify knowledge graph for a Unity project (Windows, free, no LLM). Use when adding Graphify to a Unity repo, when the graph is stale or the watcher misbehaves, or before scoping a large C# codebase with query/path/explain.

## hotbar
- hotbar-inventory - Hotbar and inventory: Data_Inventory shape, static hotbar with selection event and slot fallback, scroll panel of owned tools, equip classes and locking rules. Use when adding a tool bar, backpack list or equipment slots.

## house
- house-style-foundation - Build the compact project foundation from the user's reference Unity project before clone gameplay work: framework version, singleton/global Canvas, boot, collision registry, data/factory/state/pool contracts.

## iap
- iap-catalog - Catalog-driven in-app purchases: product table, payout receiver switch, ownership data, restore, price text fallback. Use when adding products or shop packs to a clone.

## import
- import-presets - Target import settings for textures, FBX models and audio on low-end Android, enforced by presets or an AssetPostprocessor. Use when adding art or audio assets or when build size and memory are high.

## intro
- intro-camera-flyover - Level intro cutscene: bezier camera path over waypoints with the FreeLook disabled, UI hidden, then gameplay start events. Use for obby/tower intro flybys and cinematic camera moves.

## item
- item-data-driven-behavior - Rule: item and tool behavior lives in the data class, not in switch statements, with no Instantiate for throws, no per-tick allocations, no try/catch around subscriptions, and cooldown cheats in factories. Use when reviewing or writing item, weapon or ability code.

## kcc
- kcc-advanced-movement - Use when a game needs rope swing, wall jump, sink zones, force zones, fly carpet or jetpack movement states.
- kcc-character-controller - Build the Roblox-feel character with the KinematicCharacterController: states, callback pipeline, SO tuning profiles, jump graceand input structs. Use when creating or tuning the player or bot movement controller.

## ladder
- ladder-climb - Ladder climbing for the KCC character: ladder collider and cache, BoxCast probe, enter/middle/exit states, jump-off and a bot nav link. Use when a map needs ladders or vertical climbs.

## legacy
- legacy-antipatterns - Catalogue of anti-patterns seen in the legacy projects (climb-tower, bike-obby, vendor modules) with fixes. Use when reading legacy code to port a mechanic, or reviewing code for these smells.
- legacy-framework-mapping - Map legacy CFramework code to CodeSketch and SketchEngine equivalents when porting a mechanic from climb-tower or bike-obby. Use when a legacy script uses CDataBlock, CValue, delegate StateMachine or lowercase instance APIs.

## localization
- localization-pipeline - Localization workflow: keys only in code, CSV export and import, lint for missing keys and length, fonts per locale, RTL, glyph preload. Use when a GDD needs more than one language.

## loot
- loot-rarity-tables - Loot and rarity tables: weighted roll, rarity asset, luck and mutation tables, pity, money-band rarity, and the rule that displayed odds equal real odds. Use when adding gacha boxes, egg luck, chest rewards or drop tables.

## mesh
- mesh-merge-baker - Bake a static map or prefab set into merged chunk meshes with generated colliders, navmesh and render-stats. Use when turning many authored parts into the shipped world or merging many renderers into one mesh with vertex colours.
- mesh-scene-combiner - Combine static meshes by material with an Editor bake and a budgeted runtime combine, excluding anything dynamic. Use when a scene has thousands of static MeshRenderers and draw calls are high.

## minigame
- minigame-registration - Minigame registration contract: enum entry, config, scene or prefab, flow hooks, result routing. Use with recipe-add-minigame when a game has several modes.

## mobile
- mobile-build-release - Build and release checks for Android (APK/AAB) and iOS: versioning, signing safety, size, permissions, store checklist. Use when building, testing on device, uploading to stores, or a build fails/is too large.
- mobile-hud-layout - Single source for mobile HUD zone map and sizes (joystick, action cluster, rails, safe area, thumb reach, touch targets, popups). Use when placing or changing any HUD element or on overlap/unreachable-button reports.
- mobile-input-controls - Touch input for Unity mobile: floating joystick, camera drag, action buttons, multi-touch separation, UI-vs-world blocking. Use when adding/fixing movement or camera controls or porting PC/Roblox controls.
- mobile-perf-audit - Audit a Unity mobile game for CPU, GC, physics, rendering, UI and memory issues with measurable fixes by impact. Use on FPS/lag/heat/draw-call questions or before a milestone build.
- mobile-urp-lighting-baseline - URP mobile lighting, fog and post preset for a Roblox-look scene plus per-tier world budgets and a budget checker. Use when setting up scene lighting or checking a render-stats report against a device tier.

## modular
- modular-avatar-parts - Modular avatar with slot parts (hair, hat, face, bag, tail) bound to a shared skeleton by bone name, preview-equip without saving, set items, pooled part prefabs. Use when the GDD has clothing/accessory customization instead of whole-character skins.

## monetization
- monetization-integration - Monetization hooks behind interfaces: rewarded/interstitial ads, IAP, daily reward, offline earnings, consent/ATT/GDPR, kids constraints, Editor mocks. Use when adding ads, IAP, shop, boosters or store compliance.

## mono
- mono-singleton-template - Write a MonoSingleton scene or persistent manager correctly (Instance vs SafeInstance, base calls, quit guard). Use when adding a manager component that must exist once.

## multi
- multi-agent-coexistence - Protocol so Claude, Codex, subagents, the human and the Editor do not overwrite each other (re-read before edit, snapshot/check/claim via workspace_guard.py). Use at session start in shared repos and when files change unexpectedly.

## native
- native-ad-beside-popup - Show a native ad next to a popup without gaps or covered content: ready-check first, pure layout, slide the popup, then show. Use when adding side/half native ads to popups or debugging an empty gap or an overlapped HUD.

## nav
- nav-traversal-link-tool - Editor tool and runtime rules for NavMesh traversal links: two-click authoring with snap, scripted parabola traversal, agent-body sync, ladder links. Use when bots must cross gaps, jumps or ladders that the baked navmesh does not connect.

## new
- new-game-bootstrap - Create a new Unity game from the template with one scripted procedure: config, token replace, project settings applier, pinned packages, ignore rules, repo preflight, human TODO list. Use when starting a new clone project.

## night
- night-lighting-mobile - Readable, pretty night for mobile scenes: moonlit ambient and fog, sun kept above horizon at low intensity, fake glow lights, tier-gated fireflies, no extra realtime lights. Use when a day/night cycle looks too dark or flat.

## npc
- npc-bots-and-enemies - Bots that act like other players plus enemy/boss AI for single-player clones: shared character systems, tiers, wander/chase, cheap pathing, population. Use when the reference is multiplayer or adding rivals/bosses.

## one
- one-material-world-shader - Render the whole world with one opaque material (plus one alpha) by moving per-part variation into vertex data, with the Game/RobloxWorld shader contract. Use when setting up world art, writing the world shader, or fixing material counts and draw calls.

## parallel
- parallel-qa-fanout - How to QA and fix many screens, modes or minigames with subagents on a single-writer Unity Editor without running out of turns or losing the Editor lock. Use when asked to QA or fix several modes, shops or screens in parallel.

## platform
- platform-kit - Reactive platform recipes (trampoline, conveyor, fade, glass bridge, force zone, kill zone, moving platform) built on the collision registry and KCC hooks. Use when building obby/tower platforms.

## playmode
- playmode-driver-recipes - Headless-ish Play Mode testing through script-execute when no game-view screenshot or input tool exists: ScreenCapture, real UI taps via EventSystem raycast, input driver, GameView aspect, save backup, blocking popups. Use when verifying UI or gameplay by Play Mode.
- playmode-script-testing - Verify features in Play Mode via MCP with small C# scripts (invoke onClick by reflection, read state, stretch timers) and screenshots, then restore saved data. Use for end-to-end checks when waiting or input is impractical.

## pool
- pool-everything - Pool anything spawned repeatedly (fx, floating text, projectiles, pickups) with PoolPrefabGlobal and PoolPrefabConfig, including adding a pooled fx. Use whenever code would Instantiate or Destroy in a gameplay loop.

## pooled
- pooled-ranked-fx - Per-object quality/rarity effects and cues on many world objects without a particle system each: register sources, one manager ranks at 5 Hz, lends pooled views to the top N for the device tier. Use for auras, glows, best-pick markers on large populations.

## price
- price-button-contract - Contract for every in-game currency price button, card or unlock row (icon + price as one centred group, red when unaffordable, attention pulse, sold/owned state, top-up flow, no store component for soft currency). Use when building or fixing any shop, price button, card or unlock row.

## procedural
- procedural-mesh-generator - Generate primitive and voxel meshes from spec tables in an Editor tool, saved as .asset with stud-scale UVs. Use when building world parts, props or eggs without hand-modelled FBX.

## profiling
- profiling-evidence - Rules and report format for claiming a performance change with evidence (what was measured, where, before and after). Use before reporting any FPS, draw-call, GC or memory improvement.

## project
- project-context-map - Create/maintain docs/PROJECT-MAP.md with an auto-scan script so agents stop re-exploring the repo. Use at project/session start on an unfamiliar codebase, after refactors, or when onboarding Codex/Claude.

## projectsettings
- projectsettings-baseline - Baseline Unity ProjectSettings, physics and URP values for low-end Android and an audit script that flags deviations. Use when setting up a project or when performance or timing looks wrong.

## qa
- qa-batch-and-fallbacks - Headless Unity runs and the QA degradation ladder: MCP, batchmode, static-only. Version pin and lock checks, NUnit parsing, ECONNREFUSED path. Use when the Editor or MCP is unavailable or for local batch runner.
- qa-editmode-validators - EditMode data and wiring validators: config references, ranges, ids, prefab and scene wiring via attributes and reflection. Use when adding configs or prefabs, or after wiring.
- qa-fix-retest-loop - Run a phase QA gate as a bounded loop: scan, test, read Console, classify failures, fix via the owning agent, retest, escalate at the cap. Use for /qa-gate or after each implementation batch.
- qa-playmode-smoke - PlayMode smoke and perf capture: boot, enter each mode through its button, input bot with goals, fail on exceptions, structural perf counters compared with a baseline. Use before calling gameplay done.
- qa-static-checks - No-Unity static scanners: missing scripts and references in YAML assets, banned APIs, layout and naming, asmdef and UnityEditor leaks, plus qa_run.py stage bookkeeping and verdicts. Use on every batch of edits.

## recipe
- recipe-add-minigame - Add a minigame or mode (enum id, scene, selection asset, factory, data, UI entry, verification). Use when a GDD adds a new playable mode or stage type.
- recipe-add-pickup - Add a collectible (coin, gem, boost) with registry collision, data write, sfx, respawn and prefab. Use when a GDD or request adds a new pickup type.
- recipe-add-skin-or-item - Add a character skin or item entry (asset, factory registration, unlock type, events, shop, save check). Use when adding purchasable or unlockable cosmetics or items.
- recipe-quests-achievements - Stat-driven quests and achievements: one stat bus, quest and achievement assets, daily and weekly resets, red dot. For quests, missions and badges.
- recipe-retention-timers - Retention timers: clock-tamper guard, offline earnings with cap, local notification table, redeem codes. Use for any feature that depends on real time away from the game.

## reference
- reference-index - One-time searchable index of the reference projects in docs/clone-plan.md; find a prefab/script/scene/tool in one query. Use on "like the reference", before reference-port/asset transfer, or when searching big projects is slow.
- reference-port - Port or match a feature from a reference project/screenshot faithfully: inspect first, compare side by side, adapt not blind-copy. Use on \"like the reference\", \"match 100%\", or \"ours looks different\".

## render
- render-parity-debugging - Find why imported or cloned models look worse than in the reference project: shader, textures, MaterialPropertyBlock, vertex colour colour space, lighting parity. Use when a ported asset renders flat, washed out, textured wrong or differently lit.

## revive
- revive-result-flow - Revive and result flow: timed revive popup, rewarded ad revive, give-up interstitial, result routing and rewards. Use for death, fail and win screens.

## roblox
- roblox-character-camera - Roblox-feel movement, jump, ragdoll, animation states and third-person camera in Unity, with stud/WalkSpeed/JumpPower conversions. Use when building or tuning player character/camera or fixing controller issues.
- roblox-genre-patterns - Catalog of Roblox genres and selectable core-loop/system patterns. Use when planning a clone or deciding which systems it needs.
- roblox-shader-kit - Routed Roblox/Lego environment foundation for visual recon, materialization, mesh baking, chunk/culling and render validation; load only when the current task needs those phases.
- roblox-world-kit - Roblox-look world kit: stud scale, palette, surface registry, modular kit pieces, assembly rules and world validation. Use when building or cloning a Roblox-style map in Unity.

## rule
- rule-editor-tool-safety - Hard safety rules for Editor generators, bakers and MCP-driven scripts (iteration caps, nested prefabs, saves, NavMesh persistence, null checks). Use before writing or running any script that mutates many scenes, prefabs or assets.
- rule-port-not-invent - Standing rule: port a reference game's visuals, prefabs, audio and UI exactly and never invent what a sister project already has. Use before creating any icon, HUD tile, arrow, pickaxe, popup or sound for a clone.
- rule-qa-validity - Avoid false QA verdicts: time scale, polluted saves, unmeasured constants, mock purchases, other agents in Play Mode. Use before trusting or reporting any test, balance or playtest result.
- rule-qa-verdicts - QA verdict vocabulary and when each is allowed: PASS, PASS-WITH-NOTES, STATIC-PASS, INCONCLUSIVE, FAIL. Use before writing any done, pass or verified claim.

## save
- save-and-crash-safety - Save safety and crash basics: backup file rotation, checksum header, version migration chain, recovery events, safe-boot flag, crash reporting. Use when touching persistence or release readiness.

## scene
- scene-authored-prefabs - Use when adding any manager, system, world piece, player/camera/GUI stack or skybox to a Unity project: build it as a prefab in Assets/_Game/Prefabs/<Feature>/ and place the instance in the scene; never spawn it at runtime. Also the folder and script naming layout.
- scene-flow-loading - Scene flow and loading: boot scene order, loader screen with real plus fake progress, one-time costs behind loading, no blocking SDK init. Use when wiring scenes and startup.
- scene-naming-conventions - Scene, prefab and asset naming conventions and folders for a clone project, checked by the naming lint. Use when creating scenes, prefabs or assets.
- scene-optimizer-bake - One-button, idempotent pre-build scene bake (combine groups, culling lists, NavMesh, waypoints) callable from the menu and from Unity MCP. Use when a scene needs several bake steps run in the right order.
- scene-teardown-safety - Prevent teardown-order bugs when switching scenes or modes: destroyed pooled objects in OnDisable, surviving popup roots, leaked tweens/tasks/listeners, duplicate singletons. Use when adding scene or mode switching, pools, or after a MissingReferenceException on exit.

## senior
- senior-tester - Act as a senior tester on any software or game: normal-user flows first, then exploratory, abuse, interruption, boundary and extreme-state testing, soak runs, unique bug signatures, fix-and-replay. Use when asked to test, find bugs, break it, QA, or before calling anything done or releasing.

## settings
- settings-pause-offline - Settings screen, pause popup and app pause/resume handling: toggles, language, quality, restore, privacy rows, timeScale and audio group. Use when building settings or pause.

## sfx
- sfx-variation-ducking - Add pitch/clip variation, per-config cooldowns and music ducking to the audio system. Use when repeated sound effects feel robotic, stack up, or voice lines drown in music.

## shop
- shop-skin-preview - Skin shop preview: default baked thumbnails, optional live 3D stage with own layer, camera, RenderTexture, light and drag-rotate, pooled lifecycle and stale-load token. Use when a shop must show characters, pets or weapons.
- shop-tab-page-checklist - Use when building or fixing any in-game shop with a tab column and card pages (gem/cash/offers/treadmill/trail): tab spacing, tab label size and gap-centring, card ordering by price, sparkle fx only on the best card, header currency text. Lessons from fixing a shop three times.

## simple
- simple-boss-patrol-chase - Cheap boss/hazard enemy without pathfinding: rectangle patrol, detector trigger, chase, contact kill via the collision registry. Use for obby bosses, patrolling hazards and simple chasers.

## spec
- spec-pdf-extract - Extract text and DEMO images from a PDF/sheet spec so nothing is missed. Use whenever the user attaches a PDF/sheet spec (GDD, ad script) before planning or coding.
- spec-then-plan - Workflow for non-trivial work: clarify, compare approaches, spec, task plan with verification, review, execute with checkpoints. Use before any multi-step or risky feature, or on \"plan\"/\"spec\". Skip for small edits.

## state
- state-machine-template - Build a runtime mode with the framework StateMachine and IStateMachine state classes. Use for AI, game phases or character modes instead of boolean flag soup.

## static
- static-bus-events - Define and use StaticBus events (IEvent classes, Post, Subscribe/Unsubscribe pairing). Use when many unrelated systems must react to one notification.

## teleporter
- teleporter-pad - Teleporter pads and portals: paired or destination mode, fades, anti ping-pong, control-state restore, camera warp. Use when adding portals, zone travel pads or teleports between areas.

## text
- text-spread - Use when creating Unity screen-space or world-space reward/stat text such as +money, +speed, +luck, or damage with a left TMP Sprite icon and right TextMeshPro label.

## thrown
- thrown-bomb-aoe - Thrown items and bombs: pooled arc or linear projectiles, fuse with blink, NonAlloc blast with falloff, owner safety, optional terrain dig. Use when adding grenades, bombs, shuriken, shields, hammers or banana throws.

## token
- token-efficient-workflow - Rules that cut tokens and time: read less, query indexes, batch calls, small outputs, delegate wide search, avoid rework, clean hand-off. Use at the start of long Unity/clone sessions or when slow/costly.

## tuning
- tuning-by-probe - Tune a curve, force, speed or knockback by measuring the real outcome first: seeded probe, before/after table, reference shape scaled to the world, bounds tests. Use before editing any gameplay curve or number copied from a reference.

## tutorial
- tutorial-phase-system - Tutorial phase system: persisted phase int, per-phase HUD visibility and locks, spotlight guidance, rewards once, resume safety. Use when building the first-time tutorial.

## ui
- ui-9slice-buttons - How to cut sprite 9-slice borders (TextureImporter spriteBorder) for UI buttons, tabs and plates so Image Type=Sliced stretches with no notch, seam, dark line or broken outline at any size. Use when importing, restyling or fixing any button/tab/plate sprite, when a button shows artifacts at some size, or when a button sprite has zero borders. Part of the ui-always set: read skills/ui-always first for any UI task.
- ui-always - MANDATORY first step for ANY Unity UI work - creating or editing buttons, text/labels/TMP, icons, popups, shops, tabs, HUD, currency bars, price plates, scroll boards, prefab layout or UI screenshots (nut, chu, bang, giao dien), including work delegated to subagents. Loads the required UI skill set and the measured-centring gate; never skip, never defer to the user asking.
- ui-builder - Describe a screen as a ui-spec (layout contract), lint it, convert it to anchors, and build the prefab with an idempotent Editor builder. Use when a GDD or reference defines a screen's elements and it must come out right from one prompt.
- ui-button-anatomy - Required components and behavior of every button: press scale, click sfx on pointer down, grayscale disabled, per-state variants, notify dot, hit areas. Use when creating or auditing any button, tab or HUD icon. Part of the ui-always set: read skills/ui-always first for any UI task.
- ui-center-alignment - Mandatory centring audit for any Unity UI work (bars, pills, buttons, icon+text, currency bars, popups, tabs). Use whenever you build or edit UI; verify by script that content is geometrically centred before finishing. Part of the ui-always set: read skills/ui-always first for any UI task.
- ui-clone - UI hub for recreating a reference UI (HUD, popups, shops, boards) and routing to the other UI skills. Use when UI must look/behave like another game or shows wrong 9-slice/anchors/overlap/mirrored text. Part of the ui-always set: read skills/ui-always first for any UI task.
- ui-currency-bar-contract - Contract for every currency bar (cash, gems, speed, jump count...) in HUDs, shop headers and popups: one shared bar prefab where the icon OVERHANGS the left edge of the frame, number in the free gap, optional plus button; never an icon squeezed inside the frame. Use when building, copying or fixing any currency bar, shop header bar or balance pill.
- ui-design-tokens - Quantized UI sizes, spacing, insets and design principles mined from reference prefabs, to build consistent screens from a spec alone. Use when choosing sizes or spacing for any new UI element and no mockup supplies them.
- ui-feedback-toasts - Timing recipes for toasts, announcement banners, warning messages, count-up counters and attention loops. Use when a screen needs transient feedback (reward received, error, warning, currency change).
- ui-icon-label-layout - Lay out icon + label inside buttons, pills and price plates with a HorizontalLayoutGroup child instead of hand offsets. Use when a button has an icon and text, a currency price, or the text looks off-centre. Part of the ui-always set: read skills/ui-always first for any UI task.
- ui-ink-audit - Use automatically in EVERY Unity project, on any UI edit, Play test or screenshot: an Editor watcher audits the whole game's UI (every popup, HUD, shop, minigame screen) by pixels - icon+text centred on the MEDIUM button face, titles on their colour band, no overlaps - and reports [InkAudit] FAIL lines to fix.
- ui-layout-audit - Run an automatic layout audit on the live UI in Play Mode (text centred in the free gap between icons/buttons, overlap, padding, ScrollRect margins, missing outline, tiny fonts) and fix every violation at its shared source. Use after ANY UI change, on any screenshot showing a UI defect, and before reporting UI work done.
- ui-localization - Localization setup for UI text: Unity Localization tables, TMP localize components, per-locale fonts, RTL, glyph coverage. Use when adding languages, new UI text, or fixing missing or unreadable glyphs.
- ui-naming-conventions - Naming and folder conventions for UI prefabs and objects (Btn_, Text_, Root, Board, State_*). Use when creating UI hierarchies so builders, validators and scripts can find objects by name.
- ui-notification-dots - Default red notification dots on HUD buttons, tabs and item cards when the player can afford a better stat item or claim something. Use when starting any new game and whenever building or changing a shop, upgrade, collection or reward screen; add it without being asked. Part of the ui-always set: read skills/ui-always first for any UI task.
- ui-pattern-library - Reusable game-independent UI patterns (shops, settings, daily login, gacha, jackpot, rating, revive, inventory, rebirth, wheel, quests...) with layout contract, states, behavior and variants. Use before building any shop, list, popup or page, or when told \"same format as our other games\". Part of the ui-always set: read skills/ui-always first for any UI task.
- ui-popup-anatomy - Popup prefab tree, animation modules and timings, dim, Escape stack and page-vs-popup distinction. Use when building or fixing any popup, confirm dialog or full page. Part of the ui-always set: read skills/ui-always first for any UI task.
- ui-popup-from-demo - Build popups/HUD buttons that match demo screenshots 1:1 via an idempotent editor builder and screenshot compare loop, generating only missing icons. Use when given demo images or "match the demo exactly".
- ui-scroll-board - Rules for scroll lists/grids (shop, inventory, collections) and list+preview popups: inset ScrollRect, rounded mask, slim scrollbar, spacing, state colours. Use when creating/fixing a ScrollRect list or its preview. Part of the ui-always set: read skills/ui-always first for any UI task.
- ui-style-rules - Standing visual defaults for Roblox-style mobile UI (icon size, ad badge, text centring, dim, gaps, NEW tag, cards) from past corrections. Use before/after building any popup, shop, HUD button or card, or on \"UI looks ugly/uneven\". Part of the ui-always set: read skills/ui-always first for any UI task.
- ui-tabs - Tab strip and content panels switched by a StaticBus tab-selected event with on/off frames and notify dots. Use for side-tab shops, inventory categories and settings sections. Part of the ui-always set: read skills/ui-always first for any UI task.
- ui-text-autofit-system - MANDATORY for any UI, popup, HUD, button, world-canvas or code-built text work in a Unity project. Installs/uses the automatic TMP text fitting system (auto size, padding from frames, no overflow) so text never needs manual alignment passes or reminders. Part of the ui-always set: read skills/ui-always first for any UI task.
- ui-text-tmp - TextMeshPro conventions: fonts, outline materials, autosize, colors, raycast, number formats, optical vertical centring. Use when creating labels, titles, counters, or fixing text that overflows, sits high/low in its button, or looks unlike the reference. Part of the ui-always set: read skills/ui-always first for any UI task.
- ui-title-band-centering - Use when a popup/board has a title or header band and its title, icon or button must be centred on the visible colour band, or when text/hatch/price buttons look off-centre, or HUD bars move under a native ad. Pixel-measured, no guessing.
- ui-validator - Check a UI prefab numerically for structure, overlap, safe area, text fit, raycast, 9-slice, missing references and more at several aspect ratios, with reasoned exceptions. Use after building or changing any popup, HUD or page, before screenshots. Part of the ui-always set: read skills/ui-always first for any UI task.
- ui-visual-qa - Capture a screen at several aspect ratios, diff it against a mockup or approved golden image (pixels, SSIM, edge map) and measure text contrast, with a stdlib PNG toolchain. Use after ui-validator passes, or when a build must match a reference image. Part of the ui-always set: read skills/ui-always first for any UI task.

## unity
- unity-batch-build - Local Unity batch builds and QA gates: BuildCli, pinned Editor, environment signing, size budgets, local runner template and capped claude -p fix loop. Use when building AAB/APK or automating local build checks.
- unity-code-templates - Tested framework-free C# snippets: big-number formatter, duration formatter, pool, CullingGroup culler, FPS overlay, press feedback. Use when a task needs one and the project has no equivalent.
- unity-debugging - Systematic Unity debugging: reproduce, read first error, classify (null refs, prefab overrides, serialization, order, static state, events, raycast blocking, layers, timeScale, async) and fix the root cause. Use when something does nothing or errors.
- unity-fast-iteration - Shorten the Unity edit-compile-test loop: Enter Play Mode options, asmdefs, batched refresh, fewer reimports. Use when compile/Play is slow, MCP times out after script edits, or when setting up a project for fast iteration.
- unity-iap-port - Port the reference project's IAP stack (manager, catalog json, buy button, receiver, restore) and verify with the Editor FakeStore. Use when IAP code is disabled, a sheet lists IAP products, or buy buttons do nothing.
- unity-log-triage - Condense Editor.log/Console output into a short deduped list of real problems via a bundled script. Use whenever checking the Console after changes, on failed builds/Play Mode, or with long pasted logs.
- unity-mcp-workflow - Drive the Unity Editor through MCP safely: discover tools, inspect read-only first, edit prefab assets not scene overrides, batch, save, compile, read Console, screenshot, fallback. Use for any scene/prefab/asset/Play Mode/Console task.
- unity-project-bootstrap - Set up a new Unity 6 mobile project: packages, folders, asmdefs, URP tiers, platform settings, scene flow, git ignore/LFS, first compile check. Use when starting a game or \"init the project\".
- unity-qa-playtest - Plan and run QA for a feature or build: test matrix, Play Mode via MCP, aspect ratios, fresh/saved data, interruptions, perf sanity, bug reports. Use on \"test it\", \"QA this\", before milestones or human playtests.
- unity-ui - Canvas/popup structure for mobile uGUI: root canvas, SafeArea, PopupRoot, anchors, banner clearance, layout validation. Use when creating or changing any Canvas, HUD, popup or panel prefab. Part of the ui-always set: read skills/ui-always first for any UI task.

## user
- user-corrections-ledger - Ledger of recurring user corrections and standing decisions with reasons, to avoid repeating past mistakes. Use at the start of a build, when planning a feature, or when the user corrects something similar to a past correction.

## vertex
- vertex-color-baking - Bake colours into mesh vertex colours correctly (linear space, one helper, palette-driven) and merge renderers into one mesh. Use whenever a baker or generator writes vertex colours or a world looks washed out.

## vfx
- vfx-budget-rules - Particle and FX budgets for low-end mobile: caps per prefab, pooling, shared one-shot emitters, vendor pack hygiene. Use when adding or auditing particle effects.
- vfx-material-recipes - Shader/material recipes and traps: voxel dissolve for teleports, per-sequence material twins, MaterialPropertyBlock clobber, ported materials silently on another shader. Use for dissolve/teleport FX, material swaps during sequences, or black/flat ported skins.

## vibe
- vibe-coding-guardrails - Always-on checklist of basic AI mistakes in Unity vibe coding (guessing, huge greps, Editor timeouts, wrong rename/delete scope, skipped UI skills, unverified claims, token waste) with the habit that prevents each. Use at the start of every task and before reporting done.

## world
- world-batching-culling - Make big static worlds cheap on low-end mobile: bake meshes/materials, chunked distance culling, parity and render-stat checks. Use when a map has thousands of renderers, high draw calls, or on \"optimize the map\".
- world-canvas-ui - World-space canvas boards and slot layouts: strip imported layout groups, scale pixel layouts with pixelsPerUnitMultiplier, z-order, capacity at least data count. Use when building boards, signs or slot grids in the 3D world.
- world-label-recipes - World-space and HUD text rules: one rich-text label with rarity/size/time languages, distance size cap, TMP sprite icons, calm count-up readouts, invisible restyled text, banner backing. Use when building nameplates, egg/pet labels, money/speed pills.

## zone
- zone-level-design - Lay out zones, bases, hubs and levels for Roblox-style mobile games: progression gating, scale, walkability, landmarks, kit reuse, performance budgets. Use when building a map/zone or when the layout is cramped, empty or off-scale.
